description: Land Title Settlement Department - Maakandura, Pannala D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Cad. Map No. 420501
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, owner names, and title classifications. The content is focused entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements.
